data.description: run something like wl show WL-non-existent and the CLI outputs two errors to the console.
data.title: Double console message when wl show run on non-existent ID

data.author: Agent
data.comment:
Fix applied: removed duplicate error message in `wl show` for non-existent IDs.

**Root cause:** `src/commands/show.ts` called both `cliOut.printError()` (for non-JSON mode) AND `output.error()` (unconditionally), causing the message to appear twice on stderr.

**Fix:** Removed the redundant `cliOut.printError()` call. The `output.error()` method already handles both modes — JSON mode (structured JSON) and non-JSON mode (plain stderr message).

**Files changed:**
- `src/commands/show.ts` — removed duplicate printError call
- `src/cli-types.ts` — added missing InterviewOptions interface (pre-existing build blocker)

**Verified:** `wl show WL-non-existent` now outputs exactly one error message.
